questions.what_closes_the_position: The position is closed by execution-side fills and/or guardian close reconciliation. The portfolio update path is observational detection, not the closer itself.
what_writes_order_log_position_closed: ExecPosFSM._on_execution_close_reconciled via the shared helper when close truth is cached (03T)
questions.same_or_separate_path: Historically separate. Portfolio edge detection wrote canonical close parity, while EXECUTION_CLOSE_RECONCILED performed authoritative local reset only. 03T reuses the same helper on reconcile to close that parity gap.
what_suppresses_order_log_emission: No non-zero to zero portfolio edge observed, so the historical producer never ran.
Before 03T, EXECUTION_CLOSE_RECONCILED reset state without emitting canonical close truth.
order_logger write exceptions are best-effort logged and swallowed.
trade_lifecycle.on_close exceptions are swallowed, which can hide lifecycle close failures.
what_emits_ORDER_CANCELLED_or_ORDER_TIME: close_executor teardown and reconcile cancel helpers emit ORDER_CANCELLED / ORDER_CANCELLATION_FAILED
terminal_order_contracts emits lifecycle terminal non-fill states for ORDER_STATE_CHANGED / ORDER_REJECTED
these are not canonical POSITION_CLOSED producers

are_economics_rid_lifecycle_id_available.portfolio_edge_path: Yes, when _close_accounting_truth_by_symbol and lifecycle caches were populated by close fill handling.
are_economics_rid_lifecycle_id_available.execution_close_reconciled_payload: No. The event schema carries only symbol, rid, source, ts_ms, business_close_reconciled, and why.
are_economics_rid_lifecycle_id_available.03t_reconcile_parity_path: Yes, but only indirectly by reusing cached close_accounting truth and lifecycle caches already stored on the FSM.

questions.can_schema_validation_block_the_write: Not in the shared event_handlers emission path. There is no explicit schema validation before order_logger.write; the path is best-effort and exception swallowing is the main suppression mode.

evidence: 03R dominant rows were runtime-oriented, not builder-oriented
The historical canonical producer required a portfolio non-zero to zero edge
The authoritative reconcile path reset local state without canonical close emission
03R dominant rows counted ORPHANED_TTL as terminal trade_lifecycle evidence, which is consistent with missed canonical close emission rather than successful on_close execution

residual_mixed_causes: Alternative terminal non-fill rows with ORDER_TIMEOUT / ORDER_CANCELLED remain outside the 03T patch scope.
Decision-ledger-only and inconclusive rows remain unproven from runtime evidence alone.
